description_sq:
Shitet apartament me vendndodhje tek Kompleksi E88, ne rrugen Dritan Hoxha ne Laprak.
Apartamenti eshte tipologji 2+1 me planimetri te rregullt.
Siperfaqe totale 127.51m² dhe siperfaqe neto 109.80m²
Kati i 6-te
Orientim Veriperendim.
Organizohet ne :
1 dhome ndenje + kuzhine
2 dhoma gjumi,
2 tualete
1 depo
1 ballkon
Ndodhet ne kompleks cilesor i cili eshte i organizuar, dy kate parkimi nentoke katin perdhe dedikuar totalisht ambjenteve te biznesit. Çdo shkalle eshte e pajisur me dy ashensore cilesore.
Kompleksi eshte ne fazat perfundimtare te ndertimit.
Cilesia e ndertimit eshte shume e mire dhe disa nga karakteristikat teknike jane:
1-WC, Bide, Kasete Incasone
2-Dritare prodhim gjerman TROCAL me dopjo xham i mbushur me gaz.
3-Fasade me sistem kapot per termoizolim
4-Parket laminat
5-Izolim akustik ne ndarjet ndermjet apartamenteve
Per me shume informacion ju lutem na kontaktoni.
description_en: Apartment for sale located at Complex E88, on Dritan Hoxha street in Laprak. The apartment is a 2+1 typology with a regular floor plan. Total area 127.51m² and net area 109.80m² 6th floor Orientation Northwest. It is organized in: 1 living room + kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 1 storage room, 1 balcony. It is located in a quality complex which is organized, two floors of underground parking, the ground floor is completely dedicated to business premises. Each staircase is equipped with two quality elevators. The complex is in the final stages of construction. The quality of construction is very good and some of the technical characteristics are: 1-WC, Bidet, Cassette Incasone 2-German production TROCAL windows with double glass filled with gas. 3-Facade with hood system for thermal insulation 4-Laminate parquet 5-Acoustic insulation in the partitions between apartments For more information, please contact us.
